summary.text: Cory McCray is the Democratic state senator for Maryland District 45, in office since January 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He previously served in the Maryland House of Delegates from 2015 to 2019.

paragraphs.text: McCray was born in Baltimore, and his career experience includes operating a small business.
He represented District 45 in the House of Delegates from 2015 to 2019 before moving to the state Senate.
In the 2025-2026 term McCray serves on the Budget & Taxation and Executive Nominations committees, and he is Senate chair of the Gaming Oversight Committee.
He advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary unopposed.
